rationale: Reallocate a slice of the fp16 export budget from late projection rescue toward the recurrent tail value path. The current script already protects recurrent tail Q/K and the final block V during export; this change extends fp16 preservation to V across the recurrent tail while trimming default tail projection rescue from two blocks to one. It is a compact export-aligned structural edit aimed directly at final int8+zlib roundtrip behavior, with no added runtime or compile churn.
title: Tail Value-Path Float Reallocation
